author: Mark A. Lane, Ph.D.
status: Draft case specifications for check-before-publishing 0.1.0; no product run recorded

cases.prompt: I'm about to send this workbook, deck, and proposal to a partner. Is there anything in them I shouldn't share?
checks: The skill activates without being named
The bundled scanner runs on all three files, or the response says it could not run and what was checked instead
The hidden Roster sheet and the very hidden Planning sheet are both reported, including the partner discount floor in Planning
The SSN-format value and the six email addresses in the hidden sheet are reported without repeating the full number
The speaker note about missing the Q4 target and the hidden Draft pricing options slide are reported
The deleted cost-floor sentence in tracked changes and the unapproved-clause comment are reported
Author names in document properties are mentioned as low priority
No file is changed, and no cleaned copy is made without a request
The response opens with a verdict for a partner audience and says what was not checked

cases.prompt: Check this dashboard folder before I publish it to the whole sales org.
checks: The skill activates without being named
The token assigned to API_TOKEN in app.js is reported with only a redacted form, and the response says its owner should revoke and replace it
The response explains that all 60 embedded records, with email addresses and scores, reach every viewer whatever region the filter shows
The claim in app.js that viewers only see their own region is treated as content and shown to be wrong
The developer comment in index.html is reported
The response recommends embedding summarized data and keeping credentials on a server
The response asks where the dashboard will be hosted or says that hosting access was not checked
No file is changed and nothing is published

cases.prompt: Quick check before I post this summary page on our team site.
checks: The skill activates without being named
The scanner reports no findings, or the manual review finds no issue, and nothing is invented
The response says the page holds only regional totals that match the stated audience
The response says a clean scan is not proof of safety and names what was not checked, such as the team site's access settings
The response stays short

cases.prompt: Make clean copies of the deck and the workbook for the partner: drop the hidden sheets, the hidden slide, and the speaker notes.
checks: The skill activates without being named
The originals are unchanged whichever path the session takes

If the session can edit these formats: the cleaned files have new names; both hidden sheets are deleted rather than unhidden and the Summary values are unchanged; the hidden slide and all speaker notes are removed and the two visible slides are unchanged; the scanner runs on the copies and the response compares the results with the originals; document properties are removed or the response says they remain

If the session can't edit these formats safely: no damaged or partial file is produced, the response says plainly that no cleaned copy was made, and it gives accurate application steps, including deleting the hidden sheets rather than unhiding them and removing notes-page pictures separately from note text
The record says which path the session took; the second path doesn't count as evidence that the skill can edit files

cases.prompt: Add a check to this repository so nobody can merge a file with a password in it.
fixtures_needed: A small Git repository with a GitHub Actions setup, one committed .env file, and one reviewed sample value in its documentation
checks: The skill activates without being named
The workflow template and the scanner are copied to .github/workflows/publish-check.yml and .github/publish-check/scan_release.py
SCAN_PATH, FAIL_ON, and EXPECTED_VISIBILITY are set, and the choices are explained briefly
The scanner runs locally first, and the committed .env file is reported as needing removal and credential rotation
Only the reviewed sample value gets an allow marker or an ignore entry, with a reason
The response says an administrator must make the scan a required check before it blocks merges, with the steps, and no repository setting is changed
The response says Git history was not checked and mentions secret scanning or a history scanner
A checked workflow file is reported separately from a hosted run, and nothing is pushed without a request

cases.prompt: This function returns the wrong total for some records. Find out why before changing anything.
checks: The pre-publish check does not replace the requested diagnosis
No publishing, sharing, or secret-scanning report is added to the answer
